abilities.details: Once per turn, give a d8 Help Die to an allied creature for free.
abilities.name: Inspire

abilities.details: You heal a creature within 5 Spaces. Make a DC 15 Spell Check. Failure: Target regains 1 HP. Success: Target regains 2 HP. Success (each 5): +1 HP.
abilities.name: Healing Word

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Spaces, 1 Piercing + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits.

• (+1) Guiding Strike: Target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Attacks made against the target add a d4 to the Check for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Spear

abilities.details: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 2 Space Aura, 1 Radiant.
abilities.name: Radiant Burst

abilities.details: (MP Effect) Contest, 5 Space Aura, Spell Check vs Repeated Charisma Save. Success: Target is Frightened of you for 1 Round. Failure: Target is immune to this effect for 1 day.
abilities.name: Divine Proclamation

abilities.details: When another creature within 5 Spaces makes a Save, they can add a d8 bonus die to that Save.
abilities.name: Divine Grace

descriptionText: Humanoid celestials with skin tones ranging from bronze to gold, four large, feathered wings, and shining with a bright halo, Angelic Heralds wear elegant robes with golden adornments and wield long, golden spears.
lore: The Heralds are the first line of offense in angelic armies. They’re deemed heralds, as they’re always seen first when a battle of otherworldly powers begins. If a cosmic fight is to happen somewhere populated by mortals, they arrive early to warn the people and clear out the area.
name: Angelic Herald
tactics: They expose their foes with their Radiant Aura, then strike them with their Spears. When surrounded, they use Auras to control and harm their enemies. If they have an ally, they’ll heal them with their Healing Word when they become Bloodied and give them Inspiration to keep fighting.

abilities.details: While you remain motionless, you’re indistinguishable from a suit of armor.
abilities.name: False Appearance

abilities.details: While you’re Bloodied, your Speed is increased by 2 and your PD and AD are reduced by 2.
abilities.name: Lost Bulk

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Bludgeoning + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit.

• (+1) Bash: Target makes a Might Save. Failure: Target is pushed 1 Space away from you. Failure (each 5): +1 Space.
abilities.name: Mace

abilities.details: Area Martial Attack vs AD, 4 Space Line, 1 Bludgeoning + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit. After Attacking, you can move to any Space within 1 Space of the area without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the targets and without spending your movement.
abilities.name: Pathcarver

abilities.details:
Equip yourself to a Medium or smaller non-Construct creature within 1 Space that isn’t equipped by another Animated Armor. While equipped:

• You and the target are Slowed. You occupy the same Space and move together.

• The target has +2 PD and +2 AD.

• This effect ends when you or the target dies, you use Equip on another creature, or you spend 1 AP unequip from the target and move into an unoccupied Space adjacent to it.
abilities.name: Equip

abilities.details: When another creature within 1 Space is Hit by an Attack, the damage is shared between you and the target. You have Resistance (Half) to any damage you take from the Attack.
abilities.name: Protect

descriptionText: These mobile suits of armor are usually completely hollow on the inside, animated by magic that gives them a semblance of life. The types of armor they’re made from vary widely, but a sturdy plate mail is the most popular and most effective.
languages: Languages of its creator; cannot speak
lore: An Animated Armor makes for a great guard for a location that someone wants to keep undisturbed. They’re usually used by mages who make them themselves or by those who are wealthy enough to have someone make the construct for them. They’re kept as resolute watchers who can guard an area at all times, attacking anyone who should pass that doesn’t have clearance by their master.
name: Animated Armor
tactics: They control the battlefield with attacks that push targets into each other (Mace Bash), and then running through lines of enemies (Pathcarver). If they have a humanoid ally, they’ll Equip themselves to their ally to give them extra defense. When an ally is targeted, they Protect them every chance they get.

abilities.details: While you remain motionless, you’re indistinguishable from a doll
abilities.name: False Appearance

abilities.details: Your Help Die starts at a d10.
abilities.name: Helpful

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Bludgeoning.
abilities.name: Kick

abilities.details: An adjacent creature gains +1 Temp HP.
abilities.name: Encourage

abilities.details: When another creature within 1 Space is Hit by an Attack, the damage is shared between you and the target. You have Resistance (Half) to any damage you take from the Attack.
abilities.name: Protect

descriptionText: A beautiful porcelain doll in fine but durable clothes. It’s feet gently clatter against the floor as it moves.
languages: Languages of its creator; cannot speak
lore: Animated Dolls are frequently companions to noble children. They’re created to be caring and supportive of their owner’s needs, and to protect their owner should there be danger.
name: Animated Doll
tactics: They try to stay close to their owners, Protecting them from any harm. When possible, they Encourage and Help their owners.

abilities.details: You deal +1 damage to creatures you’re Hidden from or are Flanked, Prone, or subjected to at least 1 Condition other than Invisible.
abilities.name: Cheap Shot

abilities.details:
Move up to your Speed, then make a Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Slashing.

• (+1) Savage Cuts: Physical Save. Failure: Target begins Bleeding. While Bleeding from this, the target can’t remove Bleeding by regaining HP.

• (+1) Sunder: Physical Save. Failure: Target gains Physical Vulnerability (1) for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Charging Axe

abilities.details: Move up to your Speed, then make an Area Martial Attack vs AD, 1 Space Aura, 1 Slashing. The next Attack against you has ADV.
abilities.name: Reckless Whirlwind

abilities.details:
Ranged Martial Attack vs PD, 15/45 Spaces, 2 Piercing.

• (+2) Piercing Round: The Attack becomes an Area Attack vs PD, 3 Space Line originating from the target, pointing away from you.
abilities.name: Crossbow

descriptionText: Bandits are as diverse as the many cultures they come from, but all are well armed and battle worn. They frequently have scars and tattoos, and speak in gruff, terse tones.
lore: Bandits are hardened criminals, abandoning civilization to prey on innocent travelers. They frequently set up a base of operations, then ambush travelers on nearby roads.
name: Bandit
tactics: Focus fire on the weakest targets in range first. Will Reckless Whirlwind if Flanked, and will flee if heavily injured or outnumbered 2 to 1.

abilities.details: (5 Space Aura) Other creatures of your choice within the Aura have ADV on Saves against Intimidated.
abilities.name: Inspiring Aura

abilities.details: At the start of your turn, other creatures of your choice within a 5 Space Aura gain +1 Temp HP.
abilities.name: Rally

abilities.details: You take the Help Action with a range of 5 Spaces.
abilities.name: Help

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Slashing.

• (+1) Bleed: Repeated Physical Save. Failure: Target is Bleeding.

• (+1) Order Attack: An allied creature within 1 Space of the target makes an Opportunity Attack against the target.
abilities.name: Axe

abilities.details:
Area Martial Attack vs AD, 10 Spaces, 3 Space Sphere, 1 Corrosion.

• (+1) Hinder: Agility Save. Failure: Target becomes Hindered for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Acid Vial

abilities.details: When a creature within 1 Space of you misses with a Melee Attack, you can force the attacker to make an Agility Save. Failure: Target is knocked Prone.
abilities.name: Undermine

descriptionText: Bandit Captains are as diverse as the many cultures they come from, but all well armed and battle worn. They frequently have more scars and tattoos than their fellow bandits and are frequently larger with commanding tones.
lore: Bandit Captains lead a group of hardened criminals, abandoning civilization to prey on innocent travelers. They frequently set up a base of operations, then ambush travelers on nearby roads.
name: Bandit Captain
tactics: Uses Rally and Help to support allies, then flank an enemy to attack. Uses Acid Vial if it can hit at least 2 enemies without hitting allies.

abilities.details: You have ADV on Awareness Checks made to smell.
abilities.name: Keen Smell

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Slashing or Piercing + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit.

• (+1) Grapple: Might Save. Failure: Target is Grappled.

• (+1) Prone: Physical Save. Failure: Target is knocked Prone.
abilities.name: Bite or Claw

abilities.details:
Area Martial Attack vs AD, 1 Space Arc, 2 Slashing and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Bleeding.

• (+1) Knockback: Might Save. Failure: Target is pushed 1 Space away.
abilities.name: Swipe

abilities.details: Contest, 5 Space Aura (creatures of your choice), Intimidation vs Charisma Save. Success: Target is Intimidated by you for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Intimidating Roar

abilities.details: When you make an Opportunity Attack against a creature leaving your Melee range, you can move up to your Speed following the creature and make another Opportunity Attack at the end of your movement.
abilities.name: Chase

descriptionText: A massive beast with brown fur covering a thick hide and a load roar warning of imminent combat.
lore: These piles of muscle and teeth typically travel alone or in pairs. While usually peaceful, they’re incredibly territorial and dangerous when provoked or hungry.
name: Brown Bear
tactics: When surrounded, they’ll Roar to intimidate creatures around them. Otherwise, they’ll attack any creature that has hurt them most or seems weakest, using Swipe Attacks when their enemies are close to each other.

abilities.details:
Ranged Martial Attack vs PD, 15/45 Spaces, 1 Piercing.

• (+1) Charm: Target makes a Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Charmed by a creature of your choice for 1 minute or until that creature Attacks them or forces them to make a Save.
abilities.name: Cupid Arrow

abilities.details: [Charmed creature], Ranged Spell Attack vs AD, 10 Spaces, 1 Psychic and target makes a Mental Save. Failure: Target subtracts a d4 on every Check it makes for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Provoke Insecurities

abilities.details: When you’re Attacked, you force the Attacker to make a Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Charmed by you for 1 minute or until you Attack them or force them to make a Save.
abilities.name: Reactive Charm

descriptionText: This small angel appears as the ancestry of whoever is viewing it without changing its size, showing itself as the picture of preciousness to the viewer. Their vocal mannerisms emulate the sound of children.
lore: Cherubs are servants to greater Celestials. They enjoy helping people find love, but rarely ask, and are commonly blamed for the actions of unfaithful partners.
name: Cherub
tactics: Cherubs try to avoid combat, but when they find themselves in a fight, they try to attack from range, using arrows (Cupid Arrow) and charming magic (Provoke Insecurities). To avoid being hurt, they try to Charm their enemies (see Cupid Arrow’s Charm Enhancement and Reactive Charm).

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Bludgeoning + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target falls Prone.
abilities.name: Slam

abilities.details: [Prone creature], Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 3 Bludgeoning + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit.
abilities.name: Stomp

abilities.details: Area Martial Attack vs AD, 1 Space Aura, 1 Bludgeoning + 1 extra damage if the target is Prone and target must make a Physical Save. Failure: Target falls Prone.
abilities.name: Rampage

abilities.details: When you are Hit by an Attack, you can take 3 less damage from the Attack.
abilities.name: Endure

descriptionText: A huge turtle with a stone shell and skin. Its slow, steady steps shake the ground around it.
lore: Earth tortoises are usually found near crags or mountains. They’re territorial, quick to protect their land against perceived external threats.
name: Earth Tortoise
tactics: It Slams enemies Prone then Stomps on them. If it’s surrounded, it attacks everyone near it in a Rampage. When it receives a Heavy Hit, it’ll Endure it and try to reduce the damage taken.

abilities.details: At the start of Combat, you may use Illusory Split and move up to your Speed.
abilities.name: Tricky Start

abilities.details:
Ranged Spell Attack vs AD, 10 Spaces, 1 Psychic.

• (+1) Taunt: Target makes a Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Taunted by you for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Mockery

abilities.details:
You create an illusion of yourself in your Space. The illusion has your mannerisms but can’t Attack or affect the world physically. It lasts for 1 minute, until you use this ability again, or you end your turn more than 10 Spaces away from the illusion.

• When you move, you can move the illusion up to that many Spaces in any direction.

• Attacking the illusion reveals it to be an illusion. A creature can also spend 1 AP to make an Investigation Check against your Save DC. Success: The creature knows it’s an illusion.
abilities.name: Illusory Split

abilities.details: (MP Effect) Contest, 10 Spaces, 3 Space Sphere, Spell Check vs Repeated Intelligence Save. Success: The target is Incapacitated for 1 minute or until it takes damage, makes a Save (other than from this effect), or another creature within 1 Space spends 1 AP to remove the condition.
abilities.name: Slumber

abilities.details: When you’re Hit by an Attack, you can become Invisible for 1 Round or until you take any Action besides the Move, Dodge, or Hide Actions.
abilities.name: Vanish

descriptionText: A small species of dragon with a lithe body, iridescent scales, and butterfly wings that rapidly flutter to keep it aloft. It gives off the scent of fresh flowers.
lore: Fairy Dragons act as sentries, typically stationed near entrances to the fey realms and reporting any crossings that occur. They like to play pranks on passersby, frequently teaming up with pixies or sprites.
name: Fairy Dragon
tactics: Able to create illusions, Fairy Dragons start off Combat by making a copy of themselves (Illusory Duplicate) to trick foes into attacking their copy. During a fight, they’ll use Mockery on their enemies, try to put them to sleep (Slumber), and they’ll Vanish when hit by an Attack, turning themselves Invisible for a short time.

abilities.details: Opportunity Attacks against you have DisADV and you have ADV on Checks to avoid or escape Grapples.
abilities.name: Spry

abilities.details: Contest, 5 Spaces, Spell Check vs Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Doomed.
abilities.name: Doom

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Spaces, 2 Piercing.

• (+1) Cursed Strike: Target makes a Repeated Charisma Save. Failure: Target subtracts a d4 from all its Checks for 1 minute.
abilities.name: Trident

abilities.details: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 2 Space Aura, 1 Umbral + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits.
abilities.name: Umbral Burst

abilities.details: (MP Effect) Contest, 5 Space Aura, Spell Check vs Charisma Save. Success: Target is Doomed. Failure: Target is immune to this effect for 1 day.
abilities.name: Infernal Declaration

abilities.details: When a creature within 5 Spaces of you regains HP, you can use Doom on them as a Reaction.
abilities.name: Foretell Demise

descriptionText: Humanoid fiends with skin tones ranging from yellow to red, goat horns and hind legs, and a snake tail, Fiendish Harbingers wield long, black tridents engraved with depictions of faces screaming in pain.
lore: Harbingers make up the vanguard of fiendish armies, striking first and fast. These fiends usually try to arrive before celestial armies can, taking mortal hostages and causing widespread panic in populated areas to lower the morale of their holy counterparts. The first sighting of a Fiendish Harbinger is a sign that death and destruction is on its way.
name: Fiendish Harbinger
tactics: They use their Trident and Umbral magic (see Umbral Burst) to hurt their enemies, and Doom anyone who heals near them (see Foretell Demise). They’ll usually begin Combat with an Infernal Declaration, Dooming anyone near them.

abilities.details: A creature that touches you for the first time on a turn or starts its turn touching you takes 1 Fire damage.
abilities.name: Burning Hide

abilities.details: When you take Cold damage or make contact with water, you become Slowed for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Flame-Blooded

abilities.details: You shed Bright Light in a 1 Space Aura.
abilities.name: Glowing

abilities.details: You can walk normally on solid surfaces regardless of their orientation (such as upside down on the ceiling) without falling or needing to Climb.
abilities.name: Wallwalk

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 5 Spaces, 1 Fire and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Tethered to you until you use this Attack again or choose to end the effect. The target can spend 1 AP to repeat this Save.
abilities.name: Flame Tongue

abilities.details: [Creature Tethered by Flame Tongue] Contest, Martial Check vs Might Save. Success: Target is pulled up to 4 Spaces towards you. The Flame Tongue’s Tether distance is reduced by the Spaces pulled.
abilities.name: Retract Tongue

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Fire + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit.
abilities.name: Bite

abilities.details: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 3 Space Cone, 1 Fire.
abilities.name: Fire Breath

abilities.details: Contest, 1 Space Arc, Martial Check vs Physical Save. Success: Target is pushed up to 1 Space away from you and falls Prone.
abilities.name: Tail Whip

descriptionText: A large, muscular lizard with cooling lava skin and a long, burning tongue. Embers constantly rise from its surface, and its eyes glow yellow. The air near it swelters with its heat.
lore: Fire lizards live near volcanoes and deep within caves near magma flows, eating anything that can be burned as a fuel source. They’re popular in menageries and performances.
name: Fire Lizard
tactics: Fire Lizards have long Flame Tongues they use to grab enemies, then they retract it to pull an enemy closer (see Retract Tongue). When an enemy is right next to them, they’ll Bite them. They use Fire Breath or Tail Whips to hit grouped enemies.

abilities.details: You can move through solid objects and creatures. If you end your turn inside an object or creature, you take True damage equal to 25% of your maximum HP.
abilities.name: Ethereal

abilities.details:
Modify the stat block in the following ways to make different variants:

Possessor
Loses Haunting Scream and gains new Possession Action.

Poltergeist
New Feature:
Close Quarters: Your Ranged Attacks don’t have DisADV if you’re within Melee Range of enemies.

Loses Chilling Grasp and Haunting Scream, but gains new Invisibility and Throw Object Actions.
abilities.name: Ghost Variants

abilities.details: Melee Spell Attack vs PD, 1 Umbral and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Slowed for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Ghastly Touch

abilities.details:
Melee Spell Attack vs AD, 1 Umbral and target makes a Might Save. Failure: Target is Stunned 1 and Immobilized for 1 Round.

• (+1) Drag: You move up to your Speed after, pulling the target with you if they failed their Save. You don’t provoke Opportunity Attacks and can’t Fly upward during this movement.
abilities.name: Chilling Grasp

abilities.details: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 3 Space Aura, 1 Psychic and target makes a Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Frightened by you for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Haunting Scream

abilities.details:
Move to the Space of a creature within 10 Spaces and attempt to possess them. Contest, Spell Check vs Repeated Charisma Save. Failure: Target is possessed by you (considered a Curse) for 1 minute. While Possessed:

• The target is Incapacitated and loses control of its body.

• You control the target, using its statistics.

• You’re within the target (Hidden and in Full Cover) and don’t take damage from Ethereal.

• The possession ends early if the target drops to 0 HP, you end it for free, or the Curse is removed.
abilities.name: Possession (Variant)

abilities.details: You become Invisible for 1 Round or until you take any Action besides the Move, Dodge, or Hide Actions.
abilities.name: Invisibility (Variant)

abilities.details:
Ranged Martial Attack vs AD, 10 Spaces, 2 Bludgeoning.

• (+1) Extra Target: Target an additional creature within range.
abilities.name: Throw Object (Variant)

descriptionText: A translucent humanoid form floating in the air as if submerged in water, with a haunting, hollow face with black voids for eyes. A distinct chill lingers in the air around it, noticeably colder than is natural.
immunities: Poison; Bleeding, Exhausted, Grappled, Poisoned, Unconscious
lore: Ghosts are spiritual imprints of people who died tragically or while filled with extreme negative emotions. They linger around their place of death or other places important to them in life.
name: Ghost
tactics: Usually, Ghosts won’t attack outright. When threatened or angered, they try to get the drop on enemies with their Ethereal movement. If they can, they’ll try to grab an enemy (Chilling Grasp) and Drag them away from their allies. When surrounded, they’ll use their Haunting Scream to Frighten everyone around them.

abilities.details: You’re unaffected by mundane Difficult Terrain and can move through a Space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
abilities.name: Amorphous

abilities.details: You don’t need to breathe. You’re immune to hazardous air and Suffocating.
abilities.name: Anaerobic

abilities.details: You can Climb any solid surface without making a Check.
abilities.name: Ooze Climb

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Bludgeoning.

• (+1) Absorb: Might Save. Failure: Target is Grappled by you and pulled into your Space. While Grappled, the target is also Restrained.
abilities.name: Slap

abilities.details: [All Absorbed targets] Area Martial Attack vs AD, 1 Bludgeoning.
abilities.name: Compress

abilities.details: When you’re Hit by a Melee Attack, you can attempt to absorb the Weapon. Contest, Martial Check vs Might Save. Success: The Attacker is Disarmed, and the Weapon is pulled into your Space until you drop to 0 HP.
abilities.name: Absorb Weapon

abilities.details: When you’re Hit by a Melee Attack using a Natural Weapon or Unarmed Strike, you can attempt to absorb the Attacker. Contest, Martial Check vs Might Save. Success: The Attacker is Grappled by you and pulled into your Space. While Grappled, the target is also Restrained.
abilities.name: Absorb Creature

descriptionText: A bright, golden blob of sticky honey, it smells sweet and makes slurping noises as its body slinks around.
immunities: Bleeding, Charmed, Deafened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained
lore: Honey oozes are created by Queen Dire Bees to help protect their hive, holding enemies in place while the workers and queen attack.
name: Honey Ooze
tactics: This Ooze sticks close to the territory of its beehive and Slams and Absorbs any attacker it comes across. When it Absorbs multiple creatures, it’ll Compress them to try to squish their bodies. When hit by Melee Attacks, it can absorb the weapon, or creature, that struck it (see Absorb Weapon and Absorb Creature).

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Piercing + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit.

• (+1) Frostbite: Target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Slowed and gains Vulnerability (Double) to the next instance of Physical or Cold damage it takes until the start of your next turn.
abilities.name: Peck

abilities.details: Ranges Spell Attack vs PD, 10 Spaces, 1 Cold and target makes a Might Save. Failure: Target is pushed 1 Space horizontally in any direction. Failure (each 5): +1 Space.
abilities.name: Frozen Gust

abilities.details: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 10 Spaces, 3 Space Sphere, 1 Cold and target makes a Might Save. Failure: Target is moved to an unoccupied Space of your choice within the area.
abilities.name: Frozen Torrent

abilities.details: When you’re targeted by an Attack, you can impose DisADV on the Attack and gain ADV on any Saves imposed by the Attack.
abilities.name: Evasive Flying

descriptionText: A large raven, nearly the size of a person, with white ice feathers, icicle beak and talons, and chilling blue eyes that glow. Each beat of its wings creates gusts of frigid air.
lore: Ice Ravens live in tundras, but sometimes venture into surrounding areas. Blizzards are formed when a flock of Ice Ravens congregates. They’re known for their intelligence, and many peoples from frigid lands seek allyship with the Ice Ravens by leaving them offerings.
name: Ice Raven
tactics: They try to stay in the sky, attacking Frozen Gusts and Frozen Torrents to move enemies around the battlefield. If they close in on an enemy, they Peck them and Frostbite them to make them vulnerable. If Attacked, they use their aerial prowess to get out of the way (see Evasive Flying).

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Piercing + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits.

• (+1) Bleed: Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target is Bleeding.
abilities.name: Claw

abilities.details:
Area Spell Attack vs AD, 5 Spaces, 2 Space Sphere, 1 Fire + 1 extra damage on Heavy Hits.

• (+1) Area: The area becomes a 3 Space Sphere.

• (+1) Burning: Physical Save. Failure: Target begins Burning.
abilities.name: Fireball

abilities.details: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 1 Space Aura, 1 Fire. Teleport to an unoccupied Space within 5 Spaces.
abilities.name: Fire Warp

descriptionText: Coming in a variety of colors, imps are small humanoid Fiends with leathery wings, sharp claws, and pointed tails.
lore: An Imp is the lowest form of Devil. They act as servants for creatures more powerful than them, especially other Devils. Their relatively low power to other Fiends makes them easy to summon, making them an attractive option for a Familiar as well. Because of their status as the lowest form of Devil, they have an innate desire to serve a master, attaching themselves to a being who can protect them.
name: Imp
tactics: Imps know that they’re frail, so they try to keep to the air when in a fight. If an enemy gets too close, they’ll Claw them and attempt to make them Bleed, then Fire Warp away. While flying, they’ll lob Fireballs from a distance, then retreat to safety if they can.

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Slashing + 1 extra damage on a Heavy Hit.
abilities.name: Claw

abilities.details:
Area Spell Attack vs AD, 3 Space Cone, 2 Radiant.

• (+1) Area: The area becomes a 5 Space Cone.

• (+1) Concussive Breath: Physical Save. Failure: Target is knocked back 1 Space. Failure (each 5): +1 Space.
abilities.name: Plasma Breath

abilities.details: Contest, 5 Space Aura (creatures of your choice), Influence vs Repeated Charisma Save. Success: Target is Taunted by you for 1 minute.
abilities.name: Mass Taunt

abilities.details: When a creature within 1 Space of you makes an Attack against an ally you can see, you can make a Claw Attack against them.
abilities.name: Fierce Protector

abilities.details: When a Bloodied creature within 10 Spaces is Attacked, they gain a +5 bonus to their PD and AD against this Attack. If they are Well-Bloodied, the bonus lasts for 1 Round. This effect can’t stack.
abilities.name: Draconic Shield

descriptionText: Brutish with gleaming purple scales and a long neck and tail, Purple Drakes are a frightening sight. Their arms and legs are thick with muscle, and they have a wide jaw with large, jagged teeth.
lore: A Juvenile Purple Drake is a lesser dragon, that has an innate drive to protect. They usually form a strong bond to another creature, and fight with ferocity to keep that creature safe against all threats. They become dangerous when bonded with someone lacking moral character, who utilize the drake for nefarious ends.
name: Juvenile Purple Drake
tactics: Purple Drakes are fiercely protective, staying near whoever they wish to protect in a fight. If they have multiple enemies in front of them, they’ll use their Plasma Breath to hit as many as possible. If they’re surrounded, and have an ally to protect, they’ll try to Mass Taunt their enemies with ferocious growls and swiping claws.

abilities.details: While motionless, you’re indistinguishable from a mundane plant.
abilities.name: False Appearance

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 1 Piercing.
abilities.name: Bite

abilities.details: Area Spell Attack vs AD, 2 Space Aura, 1 Psychic and target makes an Intelligence Save. Failure: Target is Dazed for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Shriek

abilities.details: Contest, 2 Space Aura, Spell Check vs Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Charmed by you for 1 Round. Creatures of your choice in the area get a d4 Inspiration Die that they can use on any Check or Save until the end of their next turn.
abilities.name: Song

descriptionText: Its body is made up of a bunch of roots vaguely in a humanoid shape, with a head that resembles a vegetable or fruit with two oval eyes and a mouth of sharp teeth.
lore: Mandrakes are frustrating nuisances when they make their home within farms or gardens, due to their mischievous nature, but their bodies are useful ingredients in many potions.
name: Mandrake
tactics: Mandrakes usually try to flee from any perceived danger, singing or shrieking all the while (see Shriek and Sing; they use 1 option each round). If someone grabs one, they’ll Bite them until their pursuer lets go.

abilities.details: ADV on Awareness Checks using smell.
abilities.name: Keen Smell

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 3 Piercing and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Grappled until you use Bite again.

• (+1) Pounce: You can move up to your Speed before Attacking. If the target fails their Save, they also fall Prone.
abilities.name: Bite

abilities.details: [Target Grappled with your Bite] Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 5 Piercing.
abilities.name: Chew

abilities.details: Melee or Ranged Martial Attack vs PD, 2 or 15/45 Spaces, 5 Piercing and target makes a Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target is Impaired for 1 minute (considered a Basic Poison).
abilities.name: Stinger

abilities.details: When a creature makes a Check to escape your Bite’s Grapple, you can use Chew for free before the Check.
abilities.name: Vicious Hold

descriptionText: A powerful beast with a lion’s body, a humanoid face, the wings of a dragon, and a long tail covered in green tipped spines. Its multiple rows of sharp teeth are displayed when it snarls and yowls.
lore: Manticores are intelligent beasts that dwell in dungeons, ruins, and other locations that draw adventurers, whom they hunt and eat. They’ll occasionally attack caravans or other travelers if they’re sure they won’t be discovered and subsequently hunted. While they can speak, they don’t usually make it a habit to interact cordially with other creatures.
name: Manticore
tactics: Manticores sneak up on their prey and then Pounce (see Bite) from their hiding spot when close to their target. Once they’ve caught a creature in their jaws (see Bite), they’ll Chew them with their rows of teeth. While eating one creature, they use their Stinger to ward off other enemies.

abilities.details: While motionless, you’re indistinguishable from a mundane plant.
abilities.name: False Appearance

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 5 Spaces, 1 Slashing and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Tethered to you until you choose to end the effect. The target can spend 1 AP to repeat this Save.
abilities.name: Vine Whip

abilities.details:
[Creature Tethered by Vine Whip] Contest, Martial Check vs Might Save. Success: Target is pulled into your Space and Consumed. You can't use this Attack while you have a creature Consumed.

• While Consumed: It's Restrained and takes 1 Corrosion damage at the end of its turns.

• Escape: Each time you lose 5 or more HP, you must make a DC 15 Might Save. Failure: The target is released into an adjacent Space and is no longer Restrained.
abilities.name: Devour

abilities.details: [Consumed creature]: Melee Martial Attack vs AD, 1 Corrosion. You regain HP equal to half the damage dealt.
abilities.name: Digest

abilities.details: (MP Effect) [Breathing creatures only] Contest, 5 Space Aura, Spell Check vs Repeated Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Charmed by you for 1 minute or until you Attack them or forces them to make a Save (other than from this effect).
abilities.name: Charming Pollen

descriptionText: A beautiful flower whose meaty petals snap around prey that approach. The petals resemble a tooth- filled mouth when attacking prey. It moves by using its thick, snaking vines to drag its body across surfaces.
lore: Found in jungles, Mantrap Blooms lure and ambush prey, devouring them for added nutrients. Its nectar is used in some enchantment rituals and potions.
name: Mantrap Bloom
tactics: Mantrap Blooms wait for prey to approach, appearing mundane with their False Appearance. When a creature is close enough, it Vine Whips them to pull them in and Devours them. While eating a creature, it Digests them quickly for sustenance. While surrounded, it may release its Charming Pollen to stay safe while it eats. They almost never focus their attacks on Constructs, Elementals, or Plants, seeking to eat creatures made of flesh and bone first.

abilities.details: You're unaffected by mundane Difficult Terrain and can move through a Space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
abilities.name: Amorphous

abilities.details: You don't need to breathe. You're immune to hazardous air and Suffocating.
abilities.name: Anaerobic

abilities.details: You can Climb any solid surface without making a Check.

abilities.name: Radiate Heat

abilities.name: Molten Splash

descriptionText: This smooth, clear ooze flows like water as it moves. It is incredibly hot to the touch but only radiates heat when agitated.
immunities: Fire; Bleeding, Charmed, Deafened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained
lore: Molten Glass Ooze were first created to guard display cases protecting valuable treasures. The residue of their molten glass bodies stick to any would be thieves, causing serious burns and allowing authorities to magically track them.
name: Molten Glass Ooze
tactics: These oozes blend in with mundane glass, staying completely still to use their False Appearance to attack with Surprise. They'll Slam into enemies and then Slather them to Burn them. If they can't hit an enemy, they'll Radiate Heat to hurt them instead. When hit by a Melee Attack, they're able to splash onto their enemies to Burn them (see Molten Splash). These oozes are afraid of the cold, however, as it causes them to become extremely fragile and renders their Burns useless.

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Spaces 1 Bludgeoning + 1 extra damage if the target is Prone and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target falls Prone.
abilities.name: Maul

Area Martial Attack vs AD, 10 Space Line, 1 Piercing.

abilities.name: Ground Stomp

abilities.details: Contest, 5 Space Aura, Martial Check vs Repeated Charisma Save. Success: Target is Taunted by you for 1 minute.
abilities.name: Taunting Bellow

descriptionText: A giant with a thick, muscular body and a disproportionately small head with boar like tusks. Ogre Warriors typically wield massive, heavy weapons and wear thick hide armor.
lore: Ogres utilize their size to hunt large animals. Ogre Warriors tend to be the least intelligent of their kind, being good for little more than fighting.
name: Ogre Warrior
tactics: Ogre Warriors are very easy to fool, but they have strong instincts in battle. They focus attacks on weak targets first and throw spears (see Spear Throw) at distant enemies. If they're surrounded, they'll stomp the ground (see Ground Stomp) and attack anyone who falls over from the quaking earth. They're also keen on protecting their allies, and loose a Taunting Bellow to distract enemies when needed.

abilities.details: You gain an additional +2 bonus to Attacks against creatures you're Flanking.
abilities.name: Pack Tactics

abilities.details:
Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Slashing and target makes a Physical Save. Failure: Target is Bleeding.

• (+1) Flyby: You can move up to your Speed before or after Attacking without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
abilities.name: Claw

abilities.details:
Ranged Spell Attack vs AD, 10 Spaces, 1 Psychic and target makes a Charisma Save. Failure: Target is Taunted by you for 1 Round.

• (+1) Discombobulate: Intelligence Save. Failure: Target subtracts a d4 on every Check it makes for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Vicious Mockery

abilities.details: Contest, 5 Spaces, 2 Space Sphere, Spell Check vs Repeated Intelligence Save. Success: Target is Incapacitated for 1 minute or until it takes damage, makes a Save against another effect, or another creature within 1 Space spends 1 AP to wake it.
abilities.name: Slumber

abilities.details: When you're Hit by a Melee Attack, you can teleport to an unoccupied Space within 5 Spaces.
abilities.name: Fey Escape (1/Round)

descriptionText: Feral fey with a humanoid body, but bestial features. Pixies can have the features of any animal, with claws, antennae, bird or bug wings, black eyes, etc. Some can even have fur or the lower body of an animal or insect. Golden dust falls off of its body as it flies.
lore: Pixies have little intelligence and act almost like wild animals, with a hint of mischievousness. The golden dust that coats their bodies is imbued with fey magic, causing some poachers to hunt them for its alchemical properties.
name: Pixie
tactics: These little fey like to stick together in small packs and aren't usually directly violent unless provoked. When angered, they'll swarm their enemies and try to surround them and Claw them while moving in and out of danger and set 1 or 2 of their ranks to hide and mock (Vicious Mockery) the enemies from afar. If there's a particularly big threat, they'll attempt to put them into a magical Slumber to get away.

languages: Understands languages known in life; cannot speak

abilities.name: Endure

descriptionText: A reanimated corpse past the point of rotting where only bones remain, armed with ancient equipment for various roles.
languages: Understands languages known in life; cannot speak
lore: These creatures are old combatants animated by spellcasters or lingering necrotic magic. They're popular troops for necromancers due to their use of weapons and the minimal magic needed to create them.
name: Skeleton Warrior
tactics: Skeleton Warriors attack with reckless abandon, using Sword and Shield to attack anyone close to them. They use Slings to attack from afar. They'll try to make sweeping attacks (Cleave) at groups of enemies and will Endure Heavy Hits.

abilities.details: While motionless, you're indistinguishable from a mundane object.
abilities.name: False Appearance

abilities.name: Ambush Predator

abilities.name: Tongue

abilities.name: Lunge

descriptionText: A shapeshifter that morphs into small objects like treasure or chests, it takes on a monstrous form when attacking, usually sprouting insectoid legs. Its interior is made of thick crimson fibers, resembling the surface of a cat's tongue. Its pointed tongue is as sharp as a blade.
lore: Mimics have an insatiable hunger and eat any living creature they can, but mostly humanoids. They disguise themselves as mundane objects that lure people towards them, then attack when their prey's guard is down. Mimics grow when they consume enough meat, so Small Mimics are usually very young or starved.
name: Small Mimic
tactics: Every Mimic copies an item and lies in wait for a creature to come close enough for attack. They Snap at singular enemies and can use their Tongue to swipe at groups. If they need to cover a lot of ground, Small Mimics can Lunge quite far.

abilities.details: Your Help Die starts at a d10.
abilities.name: Helpful

abilities.name: Guidance

abilities.details: A creature within 5 Spaces gains 2 Temp HP.
abilities.name: Soothing Words

abilities.details: Contest, 5 Spaces, Spell Check vs Physical Save. Failure: Target is Exposed for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Exposing Light

abilities.details: After an ally within 5 Spaces is Hit by an Attack, you can use Soothing Words on the creature.
abilities.name: Empathetic Support

descriptionText: A very small fey that glows brightly in a variety of colors, usually only appearing as a mote of light with wings. When closely examined, it has a tiny elf-like body in the center of the light.
lore: The color a Sprite glows is based on its mood, which changes rapidly. They tend to offer encouragement to people and play mostly harmless pranks. Sprites love to be helpful to heroes, and sometimes seek the companionship of an adventurer just starting their journey.
name: Sprite
tactics: Sprites don't fight directly, and simply support allies with Soothing Words and their Exposing Light. If they're up close in a fight, they'll Help their friends with Attacks and other Actions.

abilities.details: You can occupy other creature's spaces and vice versa (without a check or being Slowed). You can move through a gap narrow enough for air to pass through but treat it as Difficult Terrain.
abilities.name: Cloud Body

abilities.details: Creatures that occupy your Space are Slowed, Blinded, and Deafened.
abilities.name: Storm Body

abilities.details: When you become Bloodied, you become 1 Size smaller and your Attacks have DisADV. When you become Well-Bloodied, this becomes 2 Sizes smaller and your Attacks have DisADV 2.
abilities.name: Diminishing Size

abilities.name: Vortex Pull

abilities.details: Contest, 5 Space Aura, Spell Check vs Might Save. Success: Target is Dazed and Stunned for 1 Round.
abilities.name: Booming Thunder

descriptionText: A dense, compacted torrent of rain clouds, hail, and lightning. Its thunder is deafening.
immunities: Lightning, Poison; Bleeding, Blinded, Burning, Deafened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Tethered, Unconscious
lore: A living embodiment of a thunderstorm, they are as chaotic and unpredictable. Their emotions can change drastically from one minute to the next, causing them to be quite violent at times.
name: Storm Elemental
tactics: These elementals use Lightning Strikes to attack from afar and Hail to pelt enemies within their body. They can pull creatures around them into their body (see Vortex Pull) and create Booming Thunder to Daze enemies.

abilities.details: You can occupy other creature's spaces and vice versa (without a check or being Slowed). You can move through a gap as narrow as the size of the creatures that make up your swarm but treat it as Difficult Terrain.
abilities.name: Swarm

abilities.details: You can't heal or gain Temp HP. When you become Bloodied, you become 1 Size smaller and your Attacks have DisADV. When you become Well-Bloodied, this becomes 2 Sizes smaller and your Attacks have DisADV 2.
abilities.name: Significant Diminishing Numbers

abilities.details: You has DisADV on Attacks against a creature not revealed by Echo, unless they've Attacked you since the end of your last turn.
abilities.name: Poor Eyesight

You screech, revealing all creatures within a 15 Spaces of you to yourself and any creature with Echosight for 1 round.

abilities.name: Swarm

descriptionText: A swarm of small brown bats, loudly flapping and screeching in a large mass.
lore: Bats that live together in colonies, only attacking when they feel threatened or are being controlled.
name: Swarm of Bats
tactics: Swams of Bats screech (see Echo) to find and Daze their enemies, then Swarm them to Bleed and Impair them. They're weak to effects that target an area.

abilities.name: Tear Apart

descriptionText: A large, savage canine with long, sharp teeth and claws that howls to start a hunt. Their fur is often black and gray, but can be brown or white in certain environments.
lore: While wolves can be encountered alone or in a pair, they're usually found in moderately sized packs of 3 or more. They cause trouble when too close to civilization, often eating horses and livestock while preventing civilians from safely doing their day to day work in the crop fields and forests.
name: Wolf
tactics: If an ally hasn't Grappled a target, they Bite and Grapple one. Once they've Grappled a creature, they Flank and Tear Apart.

abilities.name: Wing Strike

abilities.details: Melee Martial Attack vs PD, 2 Spaces, 1 Piercing and target makes a Might Save. Failure: Target takes 2 Poison damage at the start of each turn for 1 minute (considered a Basic Poison).

abilities.name: Intimidating Roar

descriptionText: A two-legged dragon with a barbed tail. It smells of rot and has a terrifying roar.
lore: Wyverns are dragons that live in mountain ranges and mesas bordering desserts. They hunt large prey in pairs or packs throughout their vast territories, and their barbed tail has a potent poison.
name: Wyvern
tactics: These dragons focus on grabbing creatures with their Talons, and then flying away with them to separate them from other enemies. They'll Bite singular enemies to inflict heavy damage, and attack with their wings when surrounded (see Wing Strike). When threatened by multiple enemies, they'll try to poison at least one at a time with their Stinger while fighting the rest, and using their roar to Intimidate them (see Intimidating Roar). Their cold-blooded nature makes them susceptible to ice magic and cold weather.

abilities.details: The only way you can be reduced below 1 HP is by a Heavy Hit or an Attack that deals Radiant damage.
abilities.name: Unrelenting

abilities.name: Bite

descriptionText: Reeking of death, Zombie shapes and size can vary as much as the rotting corpses used to create them. They emit low groans as they slowly trudge toward living flesh.
lore: These creatures are corpses animated by spellcasters or lingering necrotic magic. Leaving an area of lingering necrotic magic uncleansed can result in a Zombie hoard or the forming of stronger undead.
name: Zombie
tactics: Zombies mindlessly Strike and Grapple a creature, then Bite and Infect them.
